tagline: The thin client for the estate.
summary: Mobley is the operator shell for the estate: a small, updateable web client that routes requests to local search, connectors, or human review without making the browser the source of truth.

routing_rules.note: Use local evidence or Unlost first.
Use a real connector or a verified handoff.

capabilities.title: Thin client
capabilities.description: The browser stays small and updateable.
capabilities.command: Edit one manifest to revise copy, routes, and cards.

capabilities.title: State visible
capabilities.description: Surface route, status, and published limits explicitly.
capabilities.command: Render from the manifest, not from hidden memory.

capabilities.title: Action routing
capabilities.description: Classify each request before anything acts on it.
capabilities.command: Send local, connector, or human requests to the right path.

capabilities.title: Easy publishing
capabilities.description: The app is a static route with no heavy client rebuild.

contract.update_model: One manifest file controls the published copy and route rules.
contract.limits: The thin client is not the model or the execution engine.
